# FIRE OS

FIRE OS is a local-first financial independence dashboard. It opens in guest mode without authentication; guest changes remain in browser local storage. Users can optionally sign in to enable Firebase cloud sync.

## Public sections

- [Profile](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/profile): financial profile, holdings, statement import, and portfolio assumptions.
- [Dashboard](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/dashboard): net worth, asset allocation, SIP status, milestones, and market risk indicators.
- [Calculators](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/calculators): retirement, SIP, SWP, tax, insurance, emergency runway, rebalancing, and scenario models.
- [Insurance](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/insurance): life and health insurance requirement estimates.
- [Plan](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/plan): financial health, actions, milestones, cash flow, and net-worth history.
- [ESOP Tools](https://fire-os-dd6d6.web.app/esop): generic employee stock option value, exercise, currency, and tax scenarios.

## Privacy

Guest mode does not create an anonymous Firebase account and does not write guest data to Firestore. Do not enter sensitive financial data into public reports or prompts.
